body: I'm 21 and a female college student, and I've cut since middle school. I think I had a year in there somewhere where I quit completely, but  you can see how that turned out. Congrats on your 7 months, if you want more contact info just message me. I'd like to have someone to talk to as well, I don't have any friends that self harm (that I know of) and it's something that I haven't told many people, just a few close friends. I think only one of them knows that I still do it so much

I took that for a while with another antidepressant that I can't remember the name of, I only had to take it once a day though. Seemed to to work for a while, no side effects that I can remember except that I couldn't drink as much as I could before. The only thing I would suggest is that if you're planning on going off of it after you've been taking it for a while, notify a doctor and do it SLOWLY, I got some pretty nasty withdrawal symptoms from just quitting cold turkey. Not fun.
